hook_text: A line, a ray and a segment walk into a map. Count their ends.
clip_script: A line segment is a straight path between two endpoints. It has a definite length that can be measured. A ray starts at one endpoint and continues in one direction forever. A straight line continues forever in both directions. The difference is in the endpoints: a segment has two, a ray has one, a line has none.
visual_style: A town map: a road with arrows off both edges, a taxi route from a rank with one arrow, a side street with two dots; end-counters pop up 0, 1, 2.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson for parallel and perpendicular streets.
